amends.reason: The five-seed paired sign-flip design has a minimum attainable two-sided p of 2/32 = 0.0625, so no contrast can reach alpha = 0.05 regardless of magnitude. One additional fresh seed makes a single prespecified test attainable (2/64 = 0.03125).

design.seed_is_fresh: seed 47 has produced no generation anywhere in this programme

arm_excluded.constants_stripped: excluded on identifiability, fixed before any data: its five-seed difference vector contains two zero blocks (0 cannot be sign-flipped), so even a sixth all-sign-consistent block cannot bring its minimum attainable p below 0.0625. Running it cannot change its status and is not performed.

primary_test.test: exact paired sign-flip over six seed blocks (2^6 = 64 arrangements), two-sided
primary_test.prediction: the seed-47 difference is positive, matching all five existing blocks; if so p = 2/64 = 0.03125 and the effect is reported as significant at alpha = 0.05
primary_test.if_sign_flips_or_zero: report the resulting exact p without further seeds

hypotheses_and_decision_rule.multiplicity_statement: Exactly one confirmatory test is registered. Under a three-test Holm family, n=6 cannot clear the first threshold (0.03125 > 0.05/3); rather than run further seeds, the two compile contrasts are demoted to secondary and the single primary is the paper's declared primary endpoint, pass@k.
hypotheses_and_decision_rule.hard_stop: No seed beyond 47 will be added after observing any seed-47 result.
